name: Grilled Oregano Chicken Thighs with Spicy Marinated Tomatoes & Rice

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Whisk to combine the marinade and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
9 tomatoes
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl with the marinade. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, and marinated tomatoes between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
